encoding_notes: SOURCE: live HTML guide (journals.sagepub.com/author-instructions/sph) Cloudflare-blocked (403 on WebFetch AND Apify headless render); encoded from SAGE's current official PDF mirror at www.sagepub.com/docs/.../submission-guidelines_-sports-health_-sage-journals.pdf (HTTP 200), extracted via pypdf. Full clean current content — treat as TIER_A content obtained via the sagepub.com PDF mirror rather than a shell/archive.

Article-type mapping: Clinical Research (and Translational/Basic Science Research, which shares the Clinical Research abstract format) -> original_research; Systematic Reviews or Meta-analysis -> systematic_review; Clinical Reviews -> review; Case Report -> case_report; Video Tutorial (visual synopses of physical tests/rehab maneuvers/surgical techniques) -> technical_note; Letters to the Editor and Author's Response -> letter.

Omitted types (no clean enum slot): Guest Editorials -> would map to 'editorial' but excluded from article_types because they are by invitation (the guide states 'Sports Health does not accept opinion papers' with the sole exception of Guest Editorials); Infographics (standalone or supplemented pictorial articles with abstract+references) -> no slot, omitted.

Blinding: 'Sports Health utilizes a double-blind peer review process for new submissions' and 'In order to perform double-anonymized peer-review, all identifying features within photographs must be removed' -> double_blind=true, scrub_body_identifiers=true. 'It is important that NO identifying material is in the submitted manuscript' -> scrub_metadata=true. separate_title_page=false: the guide mandates a fully de-identified manuscript file but does NOT explicitly prescribe a separate title-page document; author/title metadata is entered in the ScholarOne submission site (mc.manuscriptcentral.com/sph). Photo de-id: 'Participant faces should be occluded and logo should be blurred.'

Abstract: 'An abstract that summarizes the content of the article in <350 words is required' -> max_words=350 (primary/Clinical Research type). Keywords: 'include at least 3-5 keywords at the end of all abstracts' -> min 3, max 5, required. Abstract structure varies by type (structured for research/reviews, unstructured for case reports/infographics/video tutorials). abstract.sections encodes the Clinical Research headings: 'background, hypothesis, study design, level of evidence, methods, results, conclusions, and clinical relevance'.

Other-type abstract structures (not encodable in the single abstract.sections field): Systematic Reviews/Meta-analyses headings = context, objective, data sources, study selection, study design, level of evidence, data extraction, results, conclusions. Clinical Reviews headings = context, evidence acquisition, study design, level of evidence, results, conclusions, Strength-of-Recommendation Taxonomy (SORT). Case Reports / Infographics / Video Tutorials = unstructured. Video Tutorial abstract is capped at 250 words (vs the 350-word general cap).

Word limits: 'Generally, manuscripts should be 4,500 words or less' / 'Maximum recommended text length is usually 8 pages, or 4,500 words' -> 4500 applies to original_research, systematic_review, review. Case Reports: 'no more than 1,200 words, inclusive of the abstract, text, any relevant figure legends, and references' -> manuscript_max_words=1200 (INCLUSIVE of abstract+refs+legends; abstract_max_words null because the abstract is counted within the 1200 and unstructured); 'Case reports should not include tables' -> tables_max=0. Video Tutorial (technical_note): 'Text is limited to 1,500 words, with an unstructured abstract (250 words...) and maximum of 8 references' + 'unlimited use of figures' -> 1500 / abstract 250 / refs 8 / figures no cap / tables 'used sparingly' (no numeric cap). Letters: no word limit stated -> all null.

sections={} : the guide prescribes ABSTRACT heading structures but does NOT give an ordered list of BODY section headings for any type. One partial body requirement: Clinical Research papers must end with 'Clinical Recommendations' rated with the Strength-of-Recommendation Taxonomy (SORT) — a mandated end-section but not a full order, so not encoded as a body sections array.

References: 'Sports Health follows the American Medical Association (AMA) Manual of Style' and 'use the AMA Manual of Style for format' -> style=ama. UNUSUAL ordering: 'References should be typed double-spaced in alphabetical order and numbered according to the alphabetical listing' -> order=alphabetical (NOT by order of citation). 'use the Index Medicus form for abbreviating journal titles' -> journal_abbrev=nlm. in_text=null: the guide never states the in-text marker format (superscript vs bracket); AMA convention is superscript but the guide gives no explicit instruction or example, so left null per accuracy-first. include_doi=false and et_al_threshold=null: both unstated in the guide.

Layout: 'Manuscript pages should be typed double-spaced with the pages and lines numbered' -> line_spacing=double, page_numbers.show=true, lines numbered. line_numbers=continuous is the standard default chosen because the enum has no null and the guide does not specify continuous vs per-page (LOW confidence). font family/size, margins, page_size, alignment, first_line_indent, running_head, headings all UNSTATED -> null/false.

Figures: separate_files=true ('Figures should be submitted in the original form created. Images embedded in Word or PowerPoint files are not acceptable'). SCHEMA GAP tiered DPI: 'Files for line drawings should be created at 1200 dpi, for color photographs at 600 dpi, and for black and white photographs at 300 dpi' -> min_dpi=300 encoded as the floor; 600 (color photo) and 1200 (line art) tiers not representable. formats=[]: the guide does NOT enumerate accepted figure file formats (only requires original high-res form; 'many image formats are not acceptable'). legends_location=figure_legends_section chosen because figures are separate files and the manuscript is a single reviewer PDF (legends must live in the text); the guide requires legends ('all figures include a legend') but does not explicitly name a dedicated section vs inline placement (enum has no null). Multi-part figures use a lowercase letter in the bottom-right corner at 10 pt; chart axes use title capitalization.

Tables: 'Tables should be included at the end of the manuscript text file' -> placement=grouped_end. 'Tables should be numbered consecutively and have a title' -> numbering=arabic; caption_position=null (a title is required but above/below not stated). Word and PDF are the preferred table file formats.

Declarations: order=[] and required=null because the guide does not prescribe an ordered declarations/disclosures block. Guide-mandated compliance items (each conditional): IRB/ethics approval letters are MANDATORY before review as of June 15 2021 with the Ethics Committee reference number and reviewing-body name; a Declaration-of-Helsinki conformance statement for experimental human studies; patient consent statement when any image/text makes the patient identifiable (case reports must state permission was granted); clinical-trial registration number + register name for trials starting after Jan 1 2019; an 'Acknowledgments' section for non-author contributors; a signed exclusive-license (copyright) form and (for systematic reviews/meta-analyses) the Sports Health Systematic Review Checklist. AI chatbots may not be listed as authors.

Misc: no submission/publication fees ('There are no fees to publish in Sports Health') but optional open access is $4,400 USD (Sage Choice). orcid_required=false (ORCID not mentioned in the guide; the earlier lossy WebFetch parse claimed 'ORCID required' but the clean pypdf text has no ORCID mention). cover_letter_required=false: a cover letter is referenced only conditionally ('If >7 authors are listed, the contribution of each author... should be explained in the cover letter'); not stated as universally required. highlights_required=null (unmentioned). title_case=null (no article-title capitalization rule; the 'title capitalization' instruction applies only to chart axis labels). Surgery reports require a minimum 2-year follow-up. P values reported to 3 digits.
ISSN=null: the guide text does not state the journal ISSN (not encoded from memory).
[schema-required default] references.in_text defaulted to 'superscript' (guide did not state the in-text citation marker; schema requires a value; inferred from reference style 'ama').
